question: With what substances should that body be continually filled in this practice?
premises: Milk serves as a source material in the procedure.
Specific filling substances are to be used.
The act of filling that body is to be performed continually.
inference: One should always fill that body with fillings derived from milk and other indicated substances.
uncertainties: The exact analysis of the fused form kṣīrādā is unclear.
The ellipsis indicates missing text, so the full list of substances is unknown.
plain_english: One should always fill that body with fillings from milk and other substances.
